sentences.en: She really cut a dash in her pink evening gown.
sentences.zh: 她穿着粉色晚礼服看起来非常抢眼。

sentences.en: The men wore tuxedos and the women wore evening gowns.
sentences.zh: 男士们穿的是燕尾服，女士们则穿着晚礼服。

sentences.en: Medical staff have been using garbage bags as protective gowns.
sentences.zh: 医护人员一直在用垃圾袋充当防护袍。

senses.zh: 长袍，礼服；女礼服，晚礼服；（法官、大学教师等穿的）制服
